task_title: Create frozen parameter ID taxonomy in ParameterIDs header with schema version
acceptance_criteria: Source/Parameters/ParameterIDs.h exists and is #pragma once guarded
ParameterIDs.h declares a schema version constant equal to 1
ParameterIDs.h declares stable string ID constants for exactly these 11 parameters: input_trim, tight_cut, mid_freq, mid_amount, drive, tone, level, pick_attack, voicing_mode, oversampling, auto_gain
No internal DSP state (crossfade, mute-fade, RMS tracker) is exposed as a parameter ID
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
